answer: The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in ferrous, expire in garden, and oasis lists each expiry. Anyone running 44 aliases hence needs 170 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4696 identities would post 1840 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
